svg.text: Why Tag Reuse is Catastrophic -- one byte sequence, two interpretations
The same message in Kafka is read by schema v1 as $50 USD. Six months later, schema v2 reuses the same tag for a
different field. Replay corrupts everything downstream.
The SAME 3 bytes (18 88 27) interpreted by two schemas:
The wire format has no way to know which schema produced the bytes. Tag numbers are the only contract -- reuse one
and old messages decode as the new type, silently.
